evidence_notes: William, 48, was diagnosed with Crohn's three years ago. He also has severe psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis. He spent two years trying different NSAIDs before his Crohn's diagnosis. He had already failed two biologics for psoriasis. He started Stelara, which helped both conditions somewhat. However, his insurance denied renewal, leading to a flare. He is struggling with physical work, financial issues, and depression. He is considering adding methotrexate to Stelara or switching biologics again.
